frames: c7/S3/Ledger index · opening balance not set

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the app opens with a centred Material app bar titled 'Ledger' with a search icon at the right, on a lighter surface with a rule under it; the frame has no title bar at all — the search field is the first thing under the status row
deviations.reason: [shared] app bar/header — tab-root screens in the frame carry no title; the S21 door (13 §3.2 row S21, parent S3) must still be reachable, which the frame does through its search field

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the search field is a dense outlined Material TextField ('Search accounts', RkRadius.md = 8 corners, ~48 px tall); the frame draws a filled paper card field, ~64 px tall with a soft hairline border and 'Search a khata'
deviations.reason: [shared] search field (text input). Copy 'Search accounts' vs 'Search a khata' is [screen] copy — the frame's word follows the canvas vocabulary, the ARB key ledger.search.hint is the app's
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05 §1; design-system text-field component; 01 §1.3 (khata is allowed consumer vocabulary)

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the filter chips are Material ChoiceChips — the selected one filled in the terracotta accent with a check mark, the rest outlined squared-off chips — and their labels are cut through the middle: the strip is a SizedBox of RkSpace.s10 = 40 px with RkSpace.s2 = 8 px vertical padding, leaving 24 px for a chip; the frame draws full-height pills (~44 px), the selected 'All' in navy with no check, the others paper with a hairline
deviations.reason: [shared] chip (filter chip: colour, shape, no check mark). The clipped labels are a [screen] defect at default size (07 §1: no clipped text; 13 §8)

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the app offers five chips 'All · Parties · Categories · Money · System' (System off the right edge); the frame draws four, 'All · People · Categories · Money'
deviations.reason: [canvas-wrong] for the count — the System filter (Opening Balance, advances, partners) is 07 §6's chip set and stays; 'Parties' vs 'People' is [screen] copy for the owner to settle in the re-skin copy pass
deviations.authority: 07 §6 (filter chips All · Parties · Categories · Money · System; F1-07-42); CLAUDE.md § Precedence (specs decide copy)

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the list surfaces are the wrong way round — the app's letter headers are a bare muted letter on paper (_LetterHeader is a Container in colorScheme.surface, s3_ledger_index_screen.dart; band 'B' sampled (251,248,240)) and its rows sit on the page colour (token bg, Bharat Power row (245,240,228)); the frame shades each letter band (token sunk, (239,233,218)) with a hairline above and below and puts the rows on paper (token surface, (251,248,240))
deviations.reason: [shared] list row (section band on sunk, rows on surface) — both surfaces are swapped, not only the band

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: rows are Material ListTiles (RkSpace.rowMinHeight = 56) with no leading icon, the name over a class subtitle ('Parties', 'Money', 'Categories', 'System'), no rule between rows, on the page colour (see the surfaces deviation); the frame draws a ~75 px row with a circled class icon at the left (shop for a supplier/category, card for bank, note for cash, person for a party), the name alone on one line, and a hairline between rows
deviations.reason: [shared] list row (leading icon circle, single line, divider). The class subtitle is the app's only class cue at present — the icon replaces it, so it can go when the icon lands

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: balances are bare figures ('₹2,450', '₹20,600', '₹1,25,000') with no Dr/Cr word, tinted green when Dr and red when Cr; the frame writes the true side after each figure ('₹2,450 Cr', '₹47,000 Dr') and tints only the Cr figure
deviations.reason: [screen] defect — S3 is a ledger, a professional surface, so the true Dr/Cr is shown plainly; today the side is carried by colour alone (MoneyText professional with favour and no showDirection, s3_ledger_index_screen.dart _list), which 07 §1 rule 3 forbids
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-10b §4 🔒 (S3 Ledger index is professional; Dr/Cr shown plainly); 07 §1 rule 3 🔒 (colour never alone); 02 §10

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the app lists the system accounts the book holds ('Cash A/c ₹0', 'Opening Balance ₹1,25,000 System') under All; the frame's All list has none
deviations.reason: [canvas-wrong] — the frame's sample book simply has none drawn; the app keeps every live account under All (the System chip filters them). Not a layout difference
deviations.authority: 07 §6 (A–Z list of every account; System filter)

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: no A–Z scrubber; the frame draws a narrow alphabet rail A…# down the right edge with the current letter highlighted
deviations.reason: [screen] — 07 §6's 'sticky alphabet rail' is met today by pinned letter headers (F1-07-42); the frame adds the side scrubber

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: an extended FAB '+ New A/C' (navy, drawn with a heavy black outline) floats at the bottom right; the frame has no FAB
deviations.reason: [screen] — the frame gives no other door to S3.1 (13 §3.2 row S3.1: bottom-sheet A/C create from the Ledger tab); ⚠️ SPEC (open): where 'New A/C' lives once the FAB goes. The black outline is [shared] (FAB theme shape side)

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the FAB covers the last account's balance once the list is longer than the screen. The list (CustomScrollView, s3_ledger_index_screen.dart) has no bottom padding for the FAB, so scrolled to the end the last row's figure lies inside the FAB (review probe: 'Zafar Traders' figure (349.7,718.5)–(366.0,741.5) inside FAB (247.5,687)–(374,743) on iOS 390; the same on Android 360). The captures show it already: S3__default__android360 and S3__opening-not-set__android360 draw the FAB over the Ramesh and Shop sales rows' figures
deviations.reason: [screen] defect — a reachable state where a balance cannot be read at any scroll position; the cure is bottom padding the FAB's height (or no FAB, as the frame draws). s3_ledger_index_screen.dart is the ledger lane's, not this audit's
deviations.authority: 07 §1 🔒 (no dead ends; nothing hidden); 13 §8 (content never covered); Material FAB guidance (list end inset)

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index · opening balance not set*: Ramesh Kumar (a person created without an opening balance, one loan of ₹500 against him) is a plain row; the frame puts a quiet accent line '(i) Opening balance not set' under his name and a person icon
deviations.reason: [screen] not built — ADR 2026-10-07b's per-account 'opening answered' flag and the S3 marker do not exist in app/lib (no match for the flag anywhere); the account is reachable today exactly as captured

deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the tab bar carries the docked centre (+) and no Inbox count badge; the frame draws four tabs (Home · Ledger · Inbox with badge '3' · Menu)
c7 S3 *Ledger index*: (any) letter-spacing on Material labels
